Overall, the Router correctly flagged the text issue in artifacts but didn't penalize the checkpoint verdict enough. The text is not just 'illegible'; it is hallucinated gibberish, which fails the functional requirement of a comic book (conveying narrative via text).

I agree with the Router's severity assessments. The text artifact is the primary defect.
